# Decision record template

**ID:** ADR-XXX
**Status:** proposed
**Source requirement:** Rxx / Revision 4 section
**Evidence gate:** if applicable

## Context

State the actual constraint and source basis. Separate owner direction from assumptions.

## Decision proposal

Specify concrete behavior, alternatives considered, security/data/compatibility consequences and required changes to contracts/tests.

## Evidence and approval

Record measured/proven facts, unresolved limits, test environment and responsible reviewer decision. Owner confirmation is needed only for changes to established owner directions or environment-specific authority, not routine implementation selections. A proposed mechanism remains unverified until the gate runs.
